From: Sam Patel <sam@brightlayer.io>

Subject: Partnership / marketplace listing: BrightLayer (GCP + Azure)

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for taking this. Quick intro: I’m Sam (Head of Partnerships) at BrightLayer — we build a data orchestration layer + fine-tuned LLM assistant for customer support use cases. We’ve had a few pilot wins and are now ready to list on cloud marketplaces (GCP and Azure) and pursue co-sell with AWS as well.

We’re aiming for a light-weight listing to start (BYOL + 30-day trial) and a co-sell program focused on ISV-led opportunities with MSP partners. Do you have a short intake checklist and an outline of co-sell readiness requirements? Also attaching our solution brief and draft SOW so your team can triage technical/commercial fit.

Key asks from our side:
- Primary intake owner on Redwood side + marketplace contact
- Pre-req evidence for GCP/Azure listing (SLA, deploy options, metering approach)
- Co-sell requirements and accepted discount bands
- Typical timeline from intake to pub (rough estimate)

Attaching: [Attachment: BrightLayer_Solution-brief.pdf (PDF, 420KB)], [Attachment: BrightLayer_SOW-draft.docx (DOCX, 80KB)]

Would love to hop on a 30-min sync this week if possible — Thurs morning PT works for us.

Best,
Sam Patel
Head of Partnerships, BrightLayer

Sam — thanks for the intro and materials. I’ve looped in Ben (sales lead for cloud partnerships), Laura (marketplace enablement) and Vivek (partner ops) so we can triage. Quick responses below and an ask to confirm a few items: 

1) Intake owner: I’ll be the lead on Redwood side for initial scoping; Vivek will create the intake ticket and coordinate evidence collection.
2) Evidence checklist: we use a consolidated template that covers SLA, data residency, KMS, metering approach and deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private). I’ve attached the co-sell requirements workbook for your team to fill (aws_co-sell_requirements.xlsx). Could you complete the metering & pricing tab and return by EOD Wed?
3) Discount bands & co-sell: Ben, can you confirm our typical ISV discount windows for early-stage partner programs (we usually request guidance if ARR < $250k).
4) Timeline: ballpark 6–10 weeks from intake to listing depends on evidence completeness; co-sell enablement can run in parallel once we have demo artifacts and a customer reference.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Thurs 10:00–10:30 PT to walk through the workbook and go/ no-go criteria. If that works, Sam please share dial details and who will attend from BrightLayer (technical + GTM).

Quick notes from the salesman brain: 
- Ask BrightLayer for expected ACV/ARR band and top 3 pilot logos (we need at least one customer reference for co-sell intro).
- Pricing: are they planning usage-based metering per inference token, or seat + host? If metering, we need the exact metering metric and a sample invoice mapping.
- Commercial asks: early-stage ISV discounts are typically 15–25% depending on commitment and co-sell contribution. If they want higher, we escalate to revenue ops.
- Also check if SSO/KMS requirements will push them to Private deployment — that adds time.

I can take lead on commercial once we have the workbook filled. Happy to join the Thurs slot if scheduled.

—Ben
